_about: Template for env/lanes.local.json: YOUR OWN lane roster (gitignored). When lanes.local.json exists it is read instead of lanes.json (config/lane-roster.ts, scripts/lib/lane-broker.mjs). One lane = one staging UCD user of yours. persona = a key in config/personas.ts (its username/password come from .staging.env-local under that persona's variable names); card = a key in src/data/cards.ts (the MyKad the emulator inserts for that user); role = main | sub; prefix = the eSim vehicle prefix you own for that lane; ready = false until the lane passed one STMS to Step 6. See ONBOARDING.md section 4.
